title: When the Wolf Sings
author: Astrid Crane
blurb: Lior Thackeray, an exiled storm-caller, has spent seven years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
